items.a: Yes, all 9 tools are completely free and no account is required.

items.q: Do I need to sign up?
items.a: No, you can use every feature right away without signing up.

items.q: What happens to my uploaded images?
items.a: They're processed on the server and deleted automatically right afterward - nothing is stored.

Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Russian, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Thai, Indonesian, Malay, Hindi, Bulgarian, Catalan, Greek, Swahili, and Arabic.

items.q: Can I process multiple images at once?
items.a: Yes - the compress, resize, convert, and rotate tools all let you upload and process several images at the same time.
JPG, PNG, WEBP, GIF, BMP, and TIFF are all supported.
